newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber up limit on further short covering.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber up limit on further short covering.

text.p: January through July CME lumber futures bulged the $10.00 per tbf daily limit as further short covering touched off buy stops, traders said.

The market was oversold after recent sharp losses and the sharp discount of futures to cash. Although cash prices are slipping and seen a lot lower in the weeks ahead, January held a $80 discount to cash early, they said.
January slipped from its limit gain in latest action to trade $8.20 higher at $405.60 per tbf. November remains pressured from long liquidation ahead of its expiration at 1205 CST, they added.
